name: Fairy Pie (Blackbird)
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Fairy pies are often presented as gifts to guests and charming hosts, their variety of fillings each providing different benefits. In addition to gaining the benefits of the pie upon eating it, you must immediately attempt a DC 20 Will save save. On a failure, you take a –1 item penalty to saves against spells and effects from fey creatures for 24 hours.

A blackbird fairy pie grants you a fly Speed of 20 feet for 10 minutes.
